instruction: Calculate the sum of all hanging mass values in column A (excluding the header) and write the result with 2 decimal places in cell F2.

metadata.explanation: Task requires calculating the sum of column A values (rows 2-30, excluding header). Verified with Python: sum=19.72 from 29 values. Evaluator checks if cell F2 contains 19.72 (±0.01 tolerance). Custom getter reads the cell value, custom metric compares with tolerance.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts cell F2 value from Excel file using openpyxl with data_only=True
Metric correctly compares numeric value with appropriate tolerance (±0.01)
Expected value 19.72 is verified from actual data calculation (sum of 29 values in column A)
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S before verification to ensure state persistence

Static warning about parameter type is false positive - metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' (expected IS the rules dict {'value': 19.72}, not {'type': 'rule', 'rules': {...}})
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the final result (value in F2) which implicitly validates calculation and 2-decimal formatting
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Instruction specifies '2 decimal places' but evaluator only checks value, not display format. However, tolerance (±0.01) effectively ensures 2-decimal precision, so acceptable.
